input.question: What is the population of Casnovia?

documents.text: Census [ 6 ] 2020 census [ edit ] As of the 2020 United States census , [ 7 ] the village had a population of 316 people . The racial makeup was 70.6 % White , 0.5 % Black , 2.5 % Asian , 5.5 % Native American , and 18.3 % from two or more races . Hispanic or Latino people of any race were 22.7 % of the population . 2010 census [ edit ] As of the census [ 8 ] of 2010 , there were 319 people , 121 households , and 94 families living
